title: Notice regarding filling up three vacant posts of Senior Scientific Officer in IPC
bodyHtml:
Notice

It is notified for information to all concerned that the Selection Committee did not found any suitable candidate for the post of Senior Scientific Officer, Group ‘A’ in the Pay Level-11 of Pay Matrix of Rs.67,700-2,08,700/- on Deputation/(ISTC) basis for which an advertisement was published in Employment News edition 03rd - 09th August, 2024 and Interview was held on 21-03-2025 at IPC, Ghaziabad.

(Manish Jain)

Senior Administrative Officer
